description: Price, daily/weekly trend and perp funding for one real-world asset (stock, ETF, commodity, index, FX). Look up by ticker (AAPL, GOLD) or by namespaced id (xyz:AAPL). Funding belongs to the PERPETUAL CONTRACT, not the underlying — `funding.apr` is the annualized rate in percent, `funding.rate` is the raw per-hour fraction. Do not use the crypto coin tools for these.
